reviews.comment: He really works hard on the slides he shares with students. However, he doesn't reply promptly to emails (or sometimes doesn't reply at all). At least 15 min late to office hours and leaves office hours early.

Groot is a great professor tasked with teaching a very hard and dense subject. Thermodynamics is very boring at times causing his lectures to be hard to follow at times. However, the whole class is based upon these lectures, including the tests, so it is very important to attend class. Two tests make up 60% of your grade!
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: His lecture slides go over what is in the book quite in-depth, and they are organized in such a way as to illustrate concepts intuitively. I recommend attending lectures live to see the animations in his slides and to annotate the PDF printout of the slides so you can study them for the exam, which is fast pasted to test conceptual knowledge.

Groot cares about his students and their success. Lecture slides contain lots of information. Sometimes it was hard to learn from him, ask questions! This is a very fast paced course so don't fall behind. He is also heavy on homework. I liked him and would take again for 303, pull as much information from him as possible and start hw early!
Heavy on derivations in lecture and homework is weighted heavily towards your final grade.
He walks through the material and shows where different equations derive from. Overall good teacher.

I enjoyed attending Groot's classes simply for his personality but we frequently spent half the lecture on proofs that we never used again while glossing over useful example problems. While tests are open book, 70 questions for 50 min exams makes it impossible to use the book or notes. The class average on the midterm was 62 and he didn't curve.

This was an 8 AM that I was always willing to wake up early for. Though the class itself covered a broad depth of material, the homework heavy structure always felt manageable and fair. Groot's lectures pair very well with his slides, so it extremely easy to follow along.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor Groot is one of the best professors I ever had because he made a difficult course like thermodynamics very manageable. His lectures are insane and can sometimes drag on since they are just PowerPoints but the concepts are tough to grasp. The exams are based 98% on the textbook and open notes.

Groot is a very good professor and gives interesting lectures. The slides he teaches from are very thorough and are available outside of class. Groot + these slides could teach the material to a 12 year old. Groot brings an energy to lecture that makes waking up for an 8 am feel worth it. Definitely take him if you have the opportunity.

Phenomenal lecturer - he speaks concisely, he answers questions well, and his slideshows are legendary. Homework is difficult but fair, and really helps you learn the material. Tests are fast paced but not unreasonable. He's passionate about the material, and clearly cares about the students. I'd retake 303 despite passing just to have Groot again

Took him over the summer, his slides are amazing and have most of the information you will need to succeed in the course. He makes lectures interesting. His exams were mostly MCQ. My only complaint is that he took extended periods of time to respond to emails, and it didn't help that the TA never replied back a single time during the semester.
Conveys materials very good, vey open after class to answer questions. Homework is challenging but vey helpful to the understanding of thermodynamics. Funny, and brings puns to lectures.
Knowledgable professor that wants his students to do well, be prepared to read through course material on your own throughout the course.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Groot is very caring. As long as you pay attention in class and understand the homworks, you'll do good on the tests
Great lectures, however the slides can be pretty confusing if you're not focused. He draws comparisons to easier to understand situations. Homework takes a while but help understanding the content.

Groot is a solid professor with a good sense of humor. The dichotomy between theoretical lectures and extremely pragmatic recitations can be difficult to navigate. From my impression from past students, one of the better AERO 212 professors at A&M in the past few years. Would take again.
Dr. Groot is a funny and caring guy. He genuinely wants his students to do well, and is fair in the grades he assigns. The homework is VERY dense, but doable.

Great professor overall, homeworks are challenging but there is always the right information provided during the lectures and in the slides. Fantastic lecturer which keeps everything interesting. Exams are not conceptually difficult but are fast paced.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr.Groot is a great guy, he obviously cares ab his students. For A303, a lot of the lecture was useless. Time was taken to derive every little equation. We hardly did example problems which made it hard to understand the capability of the equations which ultimately blurred the focus of the class. This class did not provide practical knowledge.
Absolutely amazing professor and great slides. While he was definitely strict on his guidelines and rules, he has them well defined and made learning a difficult subject actually possible.

Dr. Groot always has a great attitude towards teaching and his slides are very thorough and complete. I will say that he does lots of derivations with class time and you are left to figure out the engineering application on your own most of the time.

Professor Groot:
 - Puts a lot of effort into his slides
 - Likes questions
 - Has conceptual lectures, problem-oriented recitations, easy tests, and difficult homework
 - Is very reasonable
One of the best professors in the aerospace department. Take him.

GROOT IS AMAZING! He's super passionate about what he teaches and he's great at explaining course topics. He gives excellent feedback and is always ready to answer questions during lectures. Very respectable prof.

Groot (Koen) is a very amazing person and a talented educator. As someone who lost an arm at a very young age, it is extremely important that my professors understand the difficulties I face in their classes. For example, having to juggle all of my different assignments was very difficult. Thankfully, Groot (Koen) understood, and helped me through!

The lectures are fun with cool powerpoint slides that have animations in them, and shows every single step in great detail. The lectures go quite fast, but you should read the textbook and slides before the lecture. Homeworks are very long, but you learn more this way by solving challenging problems, so the tests aren't as important in the class.

Professor Groot is an amazing professor, he puts in a lot of time and effort into his powerpoint slides and he wants students to understand the material. The homeworks are very difficult and will take a lot of time to do, but he gives very detailed explanations through email and in office hours.

If professors were compared to Pokemons, this guy would be like a Shiny Legendary one. He is genuinely passionate about the material he teaches and is very accessible and helpful to all your questions. He Goated bro idk what else to tell you. The HW's are hard tho, but you an aerospace student you will figure it out.
Dr. Groot is an amazing professor! His powerpoints are animated to make the concepts easier to visualize, plus, he gives them to you in pdf format so you can review.

Professor Groot's teaching style exceeds the standard in every aspect. The way he presents information involves a beautifully crafted slide presentation. He says many funny things that help you remember information while also keeping you engaged throughout the lectures. The content he teaches is hard, but he makes it seem straightforward.
Definitely one of my all time favorite professors!

Dr. Groot is an amazing teacher in my opinion. He has a very positive attitude, and his classroom culture is very constructive. He will not make anyone feel bad for asking a question in class or in office hours. Slides are provided for people to print and take notes on and then use on the midterm. There is a lot of homework so don't slack!

This professor is amazing. He is enthusiastic and cares a lot about the student's learning. His class is very lecture heavy, and in that I mean there is a lot of derivations and material to go over, but Groot is very good at explaining step by step processes. Homeworks are long and thorough but tests are more conceptual and easier.
His teaching style was pretty impressive as he always did his best to engage the whole class into the class topics using his skills of presenting the lecture.

Groot is a pretty good lecturer, and makes the class engaging. The content of the class itself can be kind of difficult to understand, but the structure of this course is well organized, so it makes getting through this class pretty manageable. Would recommend taking Groot again
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Very awesome! Keeps me coming back to class with awesome lectures! Makes a hard subject accessible and fun to learn. Weekly homeworks but the notes and lectures are very, very good and they give you the tools you need to do the homeworks. The homeworks are also 60% of the grade. Would gladly take this professor again!

The exams are much easier than the homework and open notes. Beware that the homeworks are very long and can be challenging though, so start them as early as possible. The course and the lectures are interesting.
Great professor in class and even more helpful during office hours to answer any questions you have. I would highly recommend taking Groot
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Groot shows that he really cares about his students' understanding of course material. He provides very thorough, in-depth class notes that he explains effectively in class. He caters to both visual learners and concept-based learners. Groot also provides more than enough resources to succeed such as (super helpful) office hours.

Koen Groot is an amazing professor and an even better person. He provides excellent notes, lectures clearly and well, and is generally a stand-up guy. No complaints whatsoever, save perhaps for the fact that it took a long while to grade the midterm. Overall, I would highly recommend Koen Groot!

Groot is by far an S tier professor. A lot of the information required for this class is provided in his lecture notes that he improves every semester. He clearly knows how to teach and loves what he does! The homeworks can be challenging because they really make you apply what we learn in class. 10/10 would recommend :)
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Loves teaching and it is very evident as the energy is dispersed throughout the lecture.

Groot is the Goat. His power points are unbeaten. They are A LOT but they are everything you will ever need. He uses an old edition of the test book so it will be very cheap. His tests are open note and open book. He is extremely nice and wants you to learn his material. He is very accessible and can be contacted easily. Highly recommend.

I thoroughly enjoyed Prof. Groot for 212. It is a very difficult class and he takes as much stress out of it as possible. Exams are open-note, the book is not mandatory but extremely helpful. Attending his lectures helps a lot as he points out what to focus on as there is an excessive amount of material.

Professor Groot is great, you can tell he is a fantastic person in and outside of class, He assigns homework based on numbers and thus the lectures and exams are very concept heavy, take this as you will but I found it to be a favorable course structure. My biggest gripe with Groot are his dense and information-heavy slides, they make lecture dull.
Groot is a great professor, this is still a hard course but Groot makes everything so much better. Would definitely recommend

THIS AERO-212
Great professor, Exams are easy to get a B on, but difficult to get an A, they are open book/open note and exams are based off of lecture slides.
Groot is a great professor overall, my only gripe was that his lectures are very theoretical and I would like to see more practical examples integrated into his class.

I took his AERO 212 Course and really enjoyed his teaching style. The exams were conceptually and we had access to open notes (you can print the slides). Homework is where the difficulty/numbers are. The lectures were amazing, he breaks down concepts with intuitive slide animations and color-coded information. Highly recommended.

The one, the only, The Groot. What can I say other than I used to hate power point lectures and this man converted me to love them (at least his slides). He provides you with challenging homework, and Slides that give an extensive knowledge of the entire course, supplemented with a book, you would be golden when it comes to High speed aerodynamics.

Honestly, Groot is a pretty good prof. There is a lot of homework in the class but it is manageable and always doable. Groot is always available before, after, and outside of class to answer questions. The exams are open notes and not too bad if you understand the concepts.

Groot is a new professor, so I'm sure he'll improve. His lectures are rather uninteresting (unless you like slideshows) and he never really worked any problems out by hand. This is not an easy course, so stay on top of it and you'll do fine. Take advantage of extra credit - going to class isn't that important.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Unfortunatly this proffesor failed to impress. His lectures arent usefull at all. He rarely responds to email. Gives extremely long and difficult weakly homeworks. His final was 10X more difficult that then midterm. Plus he assigned a project due two days before finals which he only gave us 1 week to do instead of two like he said.

Everyone loves Groot. Groot's powerpoints are absolutely superior and the homeworks are easy if you pay attention in class. "Easy" A if you do the work diligently- get a good homework group, it's much easier with help from others. The class would only be hard if he didn't post the powerpoints or if you are in the honors section
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Mr. Groot is knowledgeable and encouraging. Some professors in the department will condescend to you or blow off your questions, Groot has never done that. He frequently takes time in lecture and office hours to answer student questions. His class is structured very fairly and he is a great resource. He is extremely organized in lecture.

One of Aero's best professors. He is engaging, inspiring, animated, positive, with a great sense of humor. In office-hours, he'll make sure you understand no matter how long it takes. He puts so much work into preparing his lectures because he wants you to learn the material but also to be excited about it. Whole-heartedly recommend, he's fantastic

Seriously the best professor in the AERO department at A&M. Actually cares about his students and if they are learning the material. Was also one of the only profs to actually adjust for the coronavirus pandemic.

Literally the best of the best in the AERO department at Texas A&M. Amazing lecturer and knows how to make you understand and master aerodynamics. He is willing to help you whenever you need. The department needs more professors like him. #groot_for_president

One of the best profs I've ever had. The concepts covered in class are difficult, but he is capable of communicating ideas clearly and will take the time to try and explain and clarify if something is missed. Can be reached outside of class for questions and is a genuinely nice person. Wonderful professor, great teacher, and great person.

Groot teaches a difficult concept in a simple manner, emphasizing the root derivation of things and including every step. He is clear, extremely funny, and understands the rigors students face in other classes. Tests were open notes, homework aided directly to student understanding, and he is available outside of class. Class structure was superb.
The man, the myth, the legend that is Groot does an exceptional job in teaching material. He is always open to questions and does his best to answer them. He's also hilarious.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Professor Groot has created amazing PowerPoint presentations that cover all the class material. Homework is challenging and often difficult, but never meaningless. When classes were forced online, Professor Groot did a great job of transitioning material to open notes. Overall, this class was excellent and I would take it again in a heartbeat.

This man is what every professor should aspire to be. He explains the concepts clearly and thoroughly, and provides great learning material in his slides to help with any confusion. Unlike many professors, he answers questions excellently, ensuring that both you and him fully understand eachother, and working until any confusion is cleared up.
Take this professor.
